messages.author: segathon
messages.text: Playing in PURE the hot and cold boosts are game changer with ducks.  Yinzers may yell at me for coaching my line up.  But when you got guys that are 3' and 4's there is a big difference for a guy at 80 speed and a guy at 63 speed.  And a guy with a 3 if hes on the high end of 62 he can stay on ice, but if hes on cold end at 48, complete liability
